title: MAVE: Reconstructing Editable 3D Blockouts from Film Shots
abstract: arXiv:2611.22464v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Animated 3D blockouts support previsualization and provide structural conditions for video generation, but manually reconstructing them from reference videos is costly. This limits both their use by creators and the production of paired training data. We introduce MAVEBench, a benchmark of 50 film shots and 416 keyframes for evaluating camera motion, spatial layout, and character blocking. We propose MAVE, a video-to-blockout framework combining Metric observation, Agentic modeling, and evidence-based VErification. It first recovers cameras, human motion, and geometric evidence in a shared metric coordinate system. An agent then constructs an editable environment under constraints from these observations, while programmatic checks report inconsistencies to guide refinement. translated_title: MAVE：从电影镜头重建可编辑的3D布局模型
translated_abstract: 动画3D布局模型（blockout）能够支持预可视化，并为视频生成提供结构性条件，但手动从参考视频中重建这些模型成本高昂。这既限制了创作者对其的使用，也限制了配对训练数据的制作。我们提出了MAVEBench，一个包含50个电影镜头和416个关键帧的基准，用于评估相机运动、空间布局和角色调度。我们提出MAVE——一个视频到布局模型的框架，它结合了度量观测、代理建模和基于证据的验证三个环节。该框架首先在统一的度量坐标系中恢复相机、人体运动和几何证据；随后，代理在这些观测结果的约束下构建可编辑的环境，同时通过程序化检查报告不一致之处以引导迭代改进。其输出是可编辑的Blender场景以及与帧对齐的布局视频。在MAVEBench上，MAVE在三个代理设置下相比基线方法将总分提升了27.5至41.1分。
tldr: MAVE是一个融合度量观测、代理建模与证据验证的视频到3D布局重建框架，能从电影镜头自动生成可编辑的Blender场景，并配套推出MAVEBench基准用于评估相机运动、空间布局和角色调度。
en_tdlr: MAVE is a video-to-blockout framework that combines metric observation, agentic modeling, and evidence-based verification to automatically reconstruct editable Blender scenes from film shots, accompanied by MAVEBench, a benchmark for evaluating camera motion, spatial layout, and character blocking.
